story:
<!-- Case: OeLL Dot -->

## Overview
Dot pattern (no edges oriented)—first step of 2-look OLL, essential fundamental for beginners.

## Recognition
- No yellow edges on top (dot pattern).
- All four edges need to be flipped.
- Most common starting position for 2-look OLL.

## Technique
1. Recognize dot pattern (no edges oriented).
2. Common algorithm: `F R U R' U' F' f R U R' U' f'`.
3. Creates yellow cross on top—ready for OcLL.

## Fingertricks
- F R U R' U' F' flows naturally (sexy-move).
- f R U R' U' f' repeats with wide f-move.
- Two similar sections create rhythm.
- Fast execution with practice.

## Common Mistakes
- Confusing with full OLL dot cases.
- Breaking rhythm between F and f sections.
- Weak f-move execution.

## Practice
- Drill 5 times—absolute fundamental.
- First algorithm for 2-look OLL.
- Master before learning OcLL.

## Related Cases
- [OeLL Line](deddal://case/OeLL-Line) – Two opposite edges oriented.
- [OeLL L](deddal://case/OeLL-L) – Two adjacent edges oriented.
- [OLL-1](deddal://case/OLL-1) – Full OLL dot case.

## Pro Tips
- MOST COMMON OeLL case (100 popularity).
- Essential 2-look OLL fundamental.
- Creates yellow cross for OcLL step.

<!-- Case: OeLL L -->

## Overview
L-shape pattern (two adjacent edges oriented)—third OeLL case using f-sexy-f' algorithm.

## Recognition
- Two adjacent yellow edges on top (L-shape).
- Forms distinctive L pattern.
- One step away from yellow cross.

## Technique
1. Position L-shape with edges on left and front.
2. Common algorithm: `f R U R' U' f'`.
3. Wide f-move variant of F-sexy-F'.

## Fingertricks
- f R U R' U' flows naturally.
- f' completes orientation.
- Fast with good f-move technique.
- Very similar to OeLL Line.

## Common Mistakes
- Not positioning L-shape correctly.
- Weak f-move execution.
- Confusing with OLL-44 (which includes corners).

## Practice
- Drill 5 times for fluency.
- Same pattern as OLL-44.
- Practice f-move technique.

## Related Cases
- [OeLL Dot](deddal://case/OeLL-Dot) – No edges oriented.
- [OeLL Line](deddal://case/OeLL-Line) – Two opposite edges oriented.
- [OLL-44](deddal://case/OLL-44) – Same algorithm with corners.

## Pro Tips
- Common OeLL case (100 popularity).
- f-sexy-f' is fundamental variant.
- Creates yellow cross for OcLL step.

<!-- Case: OeLL Line -->

## Overview
Line pattern (two opposite edges oriented)—second step of 2-look OLL, most beginner-friendly OeLL.

## Recognition
- Two opposite yellow edges on top (line pattern).
- Forms horizontal or vertical line.
- Already halfway to yellow cross.

## Technique
1. Position line horizontally (left-right).
2. Common algorithm: `F R U R' U' F'`.
3. THE most common algorithm in cubing—F-sexy-F'.

## Fingertricks
- F R U R' U' flows naturally.
- F' completes orientation.
- Lightning-fast execution.
- Absolute fundamental pattern.

## Common Mistakes
- Not positioning line correctly (must be horizontal).
- Breaking rhythm mid-algorithm.
- Confusing with OLL-45 (which includes corners).

## Practice
- Drill 3 times—easiest OeLL.
- Same algorithm as OLL-45.
- Master for sub-20 times.

## Related Cases
- [OeLL Dot](deddal://case/OeLL-Dot) – No edges oriented.
- [OeLL L](deddal://case/OeLL-L) – Two adjacent edges oriented.
- [OLL-45](deddal://case/OLL-45) – Same algorithm with corners.

## Pro Tips
- MOST beginner-friendly OeLL (100 popularity).
- F-sexy-F' is THE fundamental algorithm.
- Creates yellow cross for OcLL step.
